manual_review_queue.question: Do the generated nose and forward-fuselage regions cover the 4 m and 6 m nose test points without creating a hard edge?
Do canopy, intake, and vertical-tail regions correct the legacy hitbox height gap without overstating true internal component boundaries?
Are left/right wing signs aligned with the runtime local-coordinate convention before component binding?

outer_regions.label: nose_radome
outer_regions.rationale: Forward-most narrow body area; height corrected from audit mesh nose slice instead of expanded selection.

outer_regions.label: forward_fuselage
outer_regions.rationale: Forward fuselage and avionics/cockpit support area; covers the old 4 m/6 m nose test zone.

outer_regions.label: canopy
outer_regions.rationale: Canopy candidate aligned to the audit mesh canopy nodes; kept separate because old hitboxes understate shape.

outer_regions.label: center_fuselage
outer_regions.rationale: Main body core around fuel, avionics, and flight-control components.

outer_regions.label: intake
outer_regions.rationale: Lower intake candidate aligned to the audit mesh intake nodes for underside proximity review.

outer_regions.label: aft_fuselage_engine
outer_regions.rationale: Aft fuselage and engine bay candidate for tail-aspect blast/fragment review.

outer_regions.label: engine_nozzle
outer_regions.rationale: Rear nozzle candidate aligned to the audit mesh nozzle node for tail-on shot diagnostics.

outer_regions.label: left_wing
outer_regions.rationale: Left wing lifting surface aligned to the audit mesh wing nodes; sign naming remains review-only.

outer_regions.label: right_wing
outer_regions.rationale: Right wing lifting surface aligned to the audit mesh wing nodes; sign naming remains review-only.

outer_regions.label: left_wing_root
outer_regions.rationale: Left wing root transition corrected toward the audit mesh wing plane; useful for grazing-warhead review.

outer_regions.label: right_wing_root
outer_regions.rationale: Right wing root transition corrected toward the audit mesh wing plane; mirrored from left wing root candidate.

outer_regions.label: left_horizontal_tail
outer_regions.rationale: Left horizontal tail candidate aligned to audit mesh tail-plane nodes for aft control-surface exposure.

outer_regions.label: right_horizontal_tail
outer_regions.rationale: Right horizontal tail candidate aligned to audit mesh tail-plane nodes for aft control-surface exposure.

outer_regions.label: vertical_tail
outer_regions.rationale: Vertical tail candidate; separated because old damage boxes omit most aircraft height.
